description: ResFrac couples hydraulic-fracture propagation with reservoir flow, proppant transport, non-Newtonian additives and thermal effects. Its technical write-up describes black-oil and compositional modes and crack opening and closure equations. The provider is ResFrac developers. Coverage: The simulator represents user-defined reservoirs and fractures. The technical description has revisions from 2018 through June 2026; those are documentation dates, not field-data coverage. Access: The authors publish a maintained technical description and validation examples through arXiv. Software distribution and execution were not checked. Licence: not stated for the software; the describing arXiv preprint is under the arXiv non-exclusive distribution licence; reuse terms therefore remain unverified. Price and access terms require confirmation with the provider. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. For simulation it supports coupled fracture-treatment and production studies. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly identifies ResFrac.
